tasks.title: Setup Project Repository
tasks.description: Initialize the project repository with version control and basic structure.
tasks.details: Create a Git repository for the project. Set up the initial directory structure with folders for HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and assets. Add a README file with project details and instructions for setup.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify the repository is accessible and the directory structure is correctly set up.

tasks.title: Implement HTML5 Semantic Structure
tasks.description: Develop the HTML structure for the website using semantic elements.
tasks.details: Create an index.html file and use semantic HTML5 elements such as <header>, <nav>, <section>, <article>, and <footer> to structure the content according to the PRD. Ensure all sections like Header, Hero, Services, Advantages, Contact Form, and Footer are included.
tasks.testStrategy: Validate HTML using W3C validator to ensure semantic correctness and check for any errors.

tasks.title: Design Responsive Layout with CSS3
tasks.description: Apply CSS3 to create a responsive design using Grid and Flexbox.
tasks.details: Develop a styles.css file and use CSS Grid and Flexbox to create a responsive layout. Ensure the design adapts to different screen sizes, focusing on mobile-first design principles. Implement the specified color scheme and typography.
tasks.testStrategy: Test the layout on various devices and screen sizes to ensure responsiveness and adherence to the design specifications.

tasks.title: Develop JavaScript Interactivity
tasks.description: Implement JavaScript functionality for interactive elements.
tasks.details: Create a script.js file to handle interactive features such as the mobile hamburger menu, smooth scrolling, form validation, phone number formatting, and header background change on scroll.
tasks.testStrategy: Perform manual testing of all interactive elements to ensure they function correctly across supported browsers.

tasks.title: Create Header and Navigation
tasks.description: Develop the header section with logo, contact info, and navigation menu.
tasks.details: In the HTML file, create the header section including the company logo, contact information, and a navigation menu with dropdowns. Implement a mobile hamburger menu using JavaScript.
tasks.testStrategy: Check the header's appearance and functionality on both desktop and mobile views, ensuring the menu works as expected.

tasks.title: Build Hero Section
tasks.description: Create the hero section with a headline, description, and call-to-action.
tasks.details: Design the hero section in HTML and CSS, including a headline, service description, key metrics, and a call-to-action button. Ensure it is visually appealing and responsive.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify the hero section displays correctly on all devices and the call-to-action button is functional.

tasks.title: Implement Services and Advantages Sections
tasks.description: Develop sections to showcase services and company advantages.
tasks.details: Create the services section with cards for each service, including icons and descriptions. Develop the advantages section with numbered blocks highlighting company strengths.
tasks.testStrategy: Ensure all service cards and advantage blocks are displayed correctly and are responsive.

tasks.title: Develop Contact Form
tasks.description: Implement the contact form with field validation and submission handling.
tasks.details: Create a contact form with fields for name, phone, email, service, and description. Implement JavaScript validation for each field and simulate form submission.
tasks.testStrategy: Test form validation and submission process to ensure all fields are validated correctly and submission simulation works.

tasks.title: Design Footer Section
tasks.description: Create the footer with company information and links.
tasks.details: Develop the footer section in HTML and CSS, including company information, service links, contact details, and copyright notice. Ensure it matches the design specifications.
tasks.testStrategy: Check the footer's appearance and functionality across different devices.

tasks.title: Optimize for SEO and Performance
tasks.description: Implement basic SEO and performance optimizations.
tasks.details: Add meta tags and structured data to the HTML. Optimize images and resources for faster loading times. Ensure the site meets the performance metrics outlined in the PRD.
tasks.testStrategy: Use tools like Google PageSpeed Insights to test and verify SEO and performance optimizations.

tasks.title: Add Pricing Section with Freight Tariffs
tasks.description: Create a pricing section featuring three tariff plans: Economy, Standard, and Premium, each with service descriptions, pricing, and an order button.
tasks.details: Implement a new pricing section using modern design principles inspired by Tailblocks. The section should include three distinct tariff plans: Economy, Standard, and Premium. Each plan must have a clear and concise description of the services offered, the pricing details, and a prominent order button to encourage user interaction. Use responsive design techniques to ensure the section looks good on all devices. Consider using CSS Flexbox or Grid for layout and ensure the design is consistent with the overall site theme. Integrate any necessary JavaScript for interactive elements, such as hover effects on buttons.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that the pricing section displays correctly on various devices and screen sizes. Check that each tariff plan is clearly presented with accurate service descriptions and pricing. Ensure the order buttons are functional and lead to the correct order process. Test the section's responsiveness and visual appeal using tools like BrowserStack or responsive design mode in browsers.

tasks.title: Integrate Bootstrap 5.3 via CDN
tasks.description: Integrate Bootstrap 5.3 into the project by adding its CSS and JS files through CDN links in the HTML file, ensuring compatibility with existing styles.
tasks.details: To integrate Bootstrap 5.3, first, add the Bootstrap CSS and JS files to the HTML file using the official CDN links. Place the CSS link in the <head> section and the JS link before the closing </body> tag to ensure proper loading order. Review existing CSS styles to identify potential conflicts with Bootstrap's default styles. Use custom CSS to override Bootstrap styles where necessary to maintain the current design aesthetic. Ensure that the integration does not disrupt the layout or functionality of existing components, especially those developed in tasks 7 and 11, which involve services, advantages, and pricing sections.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that Bootstrap is correctly loaded by checking the network tab in the browser's developer tools for successful loading of Bootstrap files. Inspect the website to ensure that existing styles are not adversely affected by Bootstrap's default styles. Test the responsiveness of the site to confirm that Bootstrap's grid system is functioning correctly. Check that all interactive components, such as buttons and forms, are styled as expected and remain functional. Pay special attention to the services, advantages, and pricing sections to ensure they display correctly with Bootstrap integrated.

tasks.title: Install and Configure context7 from Upstash
tasks.description: Clone the context7 repository from Upstash, install dependencies, and integrate it into the project.
tasks.details: To integrate context7 from Upstash, start by cloning the repository from GitHub using the command `git clone https://github.com/upstash/context7.git`. Navigate into the cloned directory and install the necessary dependencies using `npm install`. Once the dependencies are installed, configure context7 according to the project's requirements. This may involve setting up environment variables or modifying configuration files to match the project's setup. Ensure that context7 is correctly integrated by updating the project's main configuration to include context7's middleware or services as needed. Review the documentation provided by Upstash for any specific integration steps or best practices.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify the integration by running the project and checking that context7 is functioning as expected. This can include testing specific features or middleware provided by context7 to ensure they are operational. Use logging or debugging tools to confirm that context7 is correctly initialized and interacting with other parts of the project. Additionally, check for any errors or warnings during the startup process that might indicate misconfiguration.

tasks.title: Optimize Website Compactness According to Updated PRD
tasks.description: Reduce the vertical space usage of the website by optimizing header height, implementing smart scrolling, compressing section paddings, and resizing service and feature cards.
tasks.details: To optimize the website's compactness, start by reducing the header height to make it less obtrusive. Implement a smart scrolling feature where the header becomes a thin strip when the user scrolls down, ensuring it remains accessible but not intrusive. Adjust the padding of all sections to be more compact, ensuring content is still readable and visually appealing. Resize the service and feature cards to occupy less vertical space while maintaining clarity and usability. Ensure all changes align with the updated Product Requirements Document (PRD) and maintain a cohesive design with the rest of the site.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify the header's reduced height and smart scrolling functionality by scrolling through the site and ensuring the header transitions smoothly to a thin strip. Check that all sections have reduced padding and that the content remains legible and aesthetically pleasing. Test the resized service and feature cards to ensure they are still functional and visually coherent. Use browser developer tools to inspect element sizes and ensure they meet the new compactness requirements. Test across different devices and screen sizes to ensure responsiveness and consistency.

tasks.title: Implement Carousel for Service Cards
tasks.description: Create a carousel to display service cards, showing three at a time, with navigation arrows and dots, while maintaining the existing card design.
tasks.details: To implement the carousel, use a JavaScript library like Swiper or Slick that supports responsive carousels. Start by duplicating the existing service card design to create a fifth card, ensuring it matches the current style. Configure the carousel to display three cards at a time, with navigation arrows on either side and dots below for navigation. Ensure the carousel is fully responsive, adapting to different screen sizes without breaking the layout. Maintain the existing design aesthetics of the cards, ensuring no visual discrepancies. Test the carousel's performance and responsiveness across various devices and browsers.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that the carousel displays exactly three cards at a time and that navigation arrows and dots function correctly. Test the carousel on multiple devices and screen sizes to ensure responsiveness. Check that the design of the cards remains consistent with the existing style. Ensure that the fifth card is a duplicate of the 'Dogruz' card and is displayed correctly within the carousel. Use browser developer tools to simulate different devices and screen sizes for thorough testing.

subtasks.title: Duplicate Existing Service Card Design
subtasks.description: Create a fifth service card by duplicating the existing design to ensure consistency in style.
subtasks.details: Access the current service card design files and duplicate one of the cards. Ensure that all design elements such as fonts, colors, and layout are consistent with the existing cards. Save the new card in the same format and location as the existing ones.
subtasks.testStrategy: Visually compare the new card with existing cards to ensure there are no discrepancies in design.

subtasks.title: Integrate JavaScript Carousel Library
subtasks.description: Set up a JavaScript carousel library like Swiper or Slick to manage the display of service cards.
subtasks.details: Choose a carousel library that supports responsive design and multiple navigation options. Include the library in the project by adding the necessary script and stylesheet links in the HTML. Initialize the carousel in the JavaScript file, ensuring it is set to display three cards at a time.
subtasks.testStrategy: Check that the library is correctly included and initialized by ensuring the carousel structure appears on the page.

subtasks.title: Configure Carousel Display Settings
subtasks.description: Adjust the carousel settings to display three cards at a time with navigation arrows and dots.
subtasks.details: Modify the carousel initialization code to set the number of visible slides to three. Enable navigation arrows and pagination dots in the carousel settings. Style the arrows and dots to match the existing design aesthetics.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify that exactly three cards are visible at a time and that navigation arrows and dots are functional and styled correctly.

subtasks.title: Ensure Carousel Responsiveness
subtasks.description: Make sure the carousel adapts to different screen sizes without breaking the layout.
subtasks.details: Use media queries to adjust the carousel settings for various screen sizes. Ensure that the number of visible cards and the size of the cards adjust appropriately on smaller screens. Test the layout on different devices to ensure it remains consistent.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test the carousel on multiple devices and screen sizes to ensure it remains responsive and visually consistent.

subtasks.title: Test Carousel Performance and Compatibility
subtasks.description: Conduct thorough testing of the carousel's performance and compatibility across various browsers and devices.
subtasks.details: Perform load testing to ensure the carousel does not negatively impact page performance. Test the carousel in different browsers to ensure compatibility. Check for any visual or functional issues that may arise in less common browsers or older versions.
subtasks.testStrategy: Use browser developer tools to monitor performance metrics and ensure the carousel functions correctly across all supported browsers.

tasks.title: Analyze Current Template Loader
tasks.description: Review and analyze the existing template-loader.js to identify issues with Bootstrap initialization and dropdown functionality.
tasks.details: Examine the template-loader.js file to understand how it initializes Bootstrap components. Identify any race conditions or incorrect script loading orders. Check for any missing or incorrect data attributes that might affect dropdown functionality.
tasks.testStrategy: Use console logs to trace the execution flow and identify where the initialization fails. Verify the presence of Bootstrap components in the DOM after header loading.

subtasks.title: Examine Script Loading Order
subtasks.description: Analyze the order in which scripts are loaded in template-loader.js to identify any issues affecting Bootstrap initialization.
subtasks.details:
Review the script tags and loading sequence in the template-loader.js file. Ensure that Bootstrap and its dependencies are loaded in the correct order to prevent initialization issues.
<info added on 2025-09-10T18:01:32.663Z>
A race condition has been identified where Bootstrap initializes before the header with dropdown elements is loaded. The Template Loader loads the header asynchronously, but Bootstrap attempts to initialize components before they appear in the DOM.
</info added on 2025-09-10T18:01:32.663Z>

subtasks.title: Check Data Attributes for Dropdowns
subtasks.description: Verify the presence and correctness of data attributes related to Bootstrap dropdown functionality in template-loader.js.
subtasks.details:
Inspect the HTML elements initialized by template-loader.js to ensure they have the correct data attributes required for Bootstrap dropdowns to function properly.
<info added on 2025-09-10T18:02:26.708Z>
Data attributes in header.html are correct: data-bs-toggle='dropdown', id='servicesDropdown', aria-labelledby='servicesDropdown', aria-expanded='false', role='button'. Simplified Bootstrap initialization code by removing duplicate click handlers and complex fallbacks, and increased delay to 200ms for proper header loading.
</info added on 2025-09-10T18:02:26.708Z>

subtasks.title: Identify Race Conditions
subtasks.description: Detect any race conditions in template-loader.js that might affect the initialization of Bootstrap components.
subtasks.details:
Use console logs and debugging tools to trace the execution flow of template-loader.js. Identify any asynchronous operations that might lead to race conditions affecting Bootstrap component initialization.
<info added on 2025-09-10T18:03:07.367Z>
A race condition was identified and resolved: Bootstrap attempted to initialize dropdown components before they appeared in the DOM following the asynchronous loading of the header. The fix involved increasing the delay from 50ms to 200ms, simplifying the initialization code, and removing conflicting event handlers.
</info added on 2025-09-10T18:03:07.367Z>

tasks.title: Refactor Bootstrap Initialization
tasks.description: Refactor the Bootstrap initialization process to ensure proper loading and functionality of dropdown menus.
tasks.details: Modify the template-loader.js to ensure Bootstrap components are initialized after the DOM is fully loaded. Use event listeners to detect when the header is loaded and then initialize the dropdowns using 'new bootstrap.Dropdown()'. Ensure that Popper.js is correctly loaded as it is required for Bootstrap dropdowns.
tasks.testStrategy: Test dropdown functionality on all pages after refactoring. Use browser console to ensure no errors are present during initialization.

subtasks.title: Ensure DOM Readiness
subtasks.description: Modify template-loader.js to ensure that Bootstrap components are initialized only after the DOM is fully loaded.
subtasks.details: Use event listeners to detect when the DOM is fully loaded before initializing any Bootstrap components.

subtasks.title: Initialize Bootstrap Components
subtasks.description: Implement the initialization of Bootstrap dropdown components using 'new bootstrap.Dropdown()' after the DOM is ready.
subtasks.details: Ensure that the dropdowns are initialized correctly by calling 'new bootstrap.Dropdown()' on the appropriate elements once the DOM is ready.

subtasks.title: Load Popper.js
subtasks.description: Ensure that Popper.js is correctly loaded as it is required for Bootstrap dropdowns.
subtasks.details: Verify that Popper.js is included and loaded before initializing Bootstrap dropdowns to avoid any functionality issues.

subtasks.title: Test Dropdown Functionality Across Pages
subtasks.description: Test the functionality of dropdown menus on all pages to ensure they work correctly after refactoring.
subtasks.details: Use browser console to ensure no errors are present during initialization and verify that dropdowns function as expected across different pages.

tasks.title: Implement Error Handling and Logging
tasks.description: Enhance the template-loader.js with error handling and logging for better diagnostics.
tasks.details: Add try-catch blocks around critical sections of the code to catch and log errors. Use console.log to output informative messages about the status of component initialization and any errors encountered.
tasks.testStrategy: Intentionally introduce errors to test the robustness of error handling. Verify that error messages are logged correctly and provide useful information for debugging.

tasks.title: Optimize Script Loading Order
tasks.description: Ensure scripts are loaded in the correct order to prevent race conditions and timing issues.
tasks.details: Review the HTML and JavaScript files to ensure scripts are loaded in the correct order. Use 'defer' or 'async' attributes appropriately to manage script execution timing. Ensure that Bootstrap and its dependencies are loaded before any custom scripts that rely on them.
tasks.testStrategy: Check the network tab in browser developer tools to verify the order of script loading. Ensure no errors related to script execution order are present.

tasks.title: Enhance Dropdown Accessibility
tasks.description: Improve the accessibility of dropdown menus for keyboard navigation.
tasks.details: Ensure dropdown menus can be navigated using the keyboard. Implement ARIA roles and attributes to improve accessibility. Ensure that focus management is handled correctly when dropdowns are opened and closed.
tasks.testStrategy: Test dropdown navigation using keyboard only. Verify that ARIA roles and attributes are correctly implemented using accessibility tools.

tasks.title: Cross-Browser Compatibility Testing
tasks.description: Test the dropdown functionality across different browsers and devices to ensure compatibility.
tasks.details: Use tools like BrowserStack or manual testing to check the dropdown functionality on Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge. Ensure that the mobile version works correctly on various devices.
tasks.testStrategy: Perform manual testing on different browsers and devices. Use automated testing tools like Playwright to ensure consistent behavior across platforms.

tasks.title: Performance Optimization
tasks.description: Optimize the performance of dropdown initialization and overall script execution.
tasks.details: Minimize delays in dropdown initialization by optimizing event listeners and script execution. Avoid memory leaks by properly managing event listeners. Consider lazy loading for non-critical scripts.
tasks.testStrategy: Use performance profiling tools to measure script execution time and memory usage. Ensure that initialization time is under 200ms.

tasks.title: Document Code and Solutions
tasks.description: Document the changes made to the code and the solutions implemented for future reference.
tasks.details: Create comprehensive documentation detailing the changes made to the template-loader.js and other scripts. Include information on the problems identified, solutions implemented, and any remaining issues or considerations.
tasks.testStrategy: Review documentation for completeness and clarity. Ensure that it provides a clear understanding of the changes made and the reasoning behind them.

tasks.title: Implement Fallback Mechanisms
tasks.description: Create fallback mechanisms for older browsers or in case of script failures.
tasks.details: Implement fallback solutions for browsers that do not support the latest JavaScript features or Bootstrap functionalities. Use polyfills or alternative approaches to ensure basic functionality is maintained.
tasks.testStrategy: Test the site on older browsers to ensure that fallback mechanisms work correctly. Verify that basic dropdown functionality is available even if advanced features are not supported.

tasks.title: Final Testing and Validation
tasks.description: Conduct final testing to ensure all issues are resolved and the site functions correctly.
tasks.details: Perform comprehensive testing across all pages and devices to ensure dropdowns work as expected. Validate that no errors are present in the console and that performance meets the specified criteria.
tasks.testStrategy: Conduct functional, performance, and cross-browser testing. Use automated tests to validate consistent behavior and manual tests for edge cases.
